summary: This annotated messaging screenshot, dated May 28, 2026, captures the official out-of-pocket cash provider visit summary for Nicolas Hernandez. It documents critical ongoing legal and reimbursement efforts, a failed transfer to an in-network provider due to administrative errors, and a severe HIPAA/privacy breach. By uploading this proof of care-interruption (due to personal fund exhaustion from the state withholding his Conlan reimbursement) into the state's ACMS portal, Nicolas Hernandez forced an immediate panic callback from the DHCS Conlan contractor, Gainwell Technologies, the very next day.
